Soracom launches Physical AI Suite for connected robot operations

The suite organizes existing services for connectivity, protection and machine management, with standard individual service pricing.

RoboticsTomorrow ↗18 November 2026English editorial summary
Story

Existing services organized for robotics

Soracom announced Physical AI Suite on November 18, organizing platform services for robots, autonomous mobile machines and industrial equipment. The change is a deployment-oriented grouping of services rather than a new robot-control model.

Connect, protect and manage remotely

Components cover binding SIMs to devices, encrypted IP-network access, private gateways, certificate management and traffic inspection. Napter provides time-limited remote maintenance access, while Flux supports AI workflows over operational data. Customers still need to configure these services for their own systems.

Available now, with service-level charges

The services are available through Soracom’s console and API in markets it serves, with customer self-configuration. There is no separate suite fee, but individual services retain their standard charges. Professional security assessment is a separate engagement; the suite itself does not establish the functional safety of a complete robot system.
